summary.headline: Solomon and Dream Interpretation
summary.text: Catalog entry for Bologna codex 18: the Testament of Solomon, son of David, with figures of the decans, followed by an index and works on dream interpretation by Syrim and Rhamboulios, plus texts on stones and bloodletting. References cite Migne, Conybeare, Istrin, and a Florentine codex.
